item.title: Vacaville shooting suspect makes court appearance
item.description: A Vacaville man arrested in connection with the shooting death of a roommate last week made a brief appearance in Solano County Superior Court on Tuesday. Michael Andrew Ward, 20, will return to the Department 23 courtroom of Judge John B. Ellis on Wednesday at 1:30 p.m. for arraignment, after telling the judge on Tuesday that he is working to hire a private attorney to represent him in court.
